subject: Stan v2.1.0 tagged; hotfix branch for v2.1.1 created

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Stan v2.1.0 tagged; hotfix branch for v2.1.1 created
parts:
I tagged Stan v2.1.0. This should be the version used for RStan and PyStan.

If you are working on a bug, please branch from:
  hotfix/v2.1.1

Label the branch:
  bugfix/issue-#-descriptor

And create the pull request pointing back to hotfix/v2.1.1. We're going to try to follow the suggested gitflow workflow.



Daniel

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Stan v2.1.0 tagged; hotfix branch for v2.1.1 created
parts:
On Monday, December 23, 2013 4:08:29 PM UTC-5, Daniel Lee wrote:
I tagged Stan v2.1.0. This should be the version used for RStan and PyStan.

If you are working on a bug, please branch from:
  hotfix/v2.1.1

Label the branch:
  bugfix/issue-#-descriptor

And create the pull request pointing back to hotfix/v2.1.1. We're going to try to follow the suggested gitflow workflow.

That isn't the gitflow workflow exactly. If there is a bug that is serious enough to merit a hotfix release, then the fix should get branched off of master. Also, it would be confusing to have a hotfix/v2.1.1 tag if it turned out to be the case that there were no bugs serious enough to merit a hotfix release before the next regular release.

Ben


Ben
